1. The vertical and horizontal folds bring four \(45^\circ\) sectors of the octagon together.

5. Unfolding the remaining folds reproduces this straight edge in each of the eight \(45^\circ\) sectors. Their endpoints form eight corners located along the original octagon’s vertex directions.

Thus, the unfolded paper has a regular octagonal hole with a point at the top, bottom, left, and right. This matches choice B.
